body:
This doesn't come up super often as `Control` is non-interpolated by default.

I confirmed that changing the position then a reset does work correctly, the problem that is occurring in your MRP is you are changing the position indirectly via the anchors.

It turns out that changing the anchors doesn't immediately update them, it is deferred, so at the point you call `reset` after changing the anchors, internally they haven't been changed.

You can get around this by calling `call_deferred("reset_physics_interpolation")`, which confirms this hypothesis. A similar order of operations problem occurs in a few other nodes that have hard coded solutions.

I'll try and have a look see whether this can be automated, or whether this simply needs to be documented.
